book.name: 2 Corinth
book.title: Paul Secon Letta Ta Dem Een Corinth

content: De Las Ting Dem wa Paul Waan Bout
Dis de tird time A da come wisit oona. Dey write een God Book say, “Ef dey say somebody do bad, fa settle de case, two or shree people haffa be dey wa done shim wen de poson done bad.”
A done waan oona wa beena sin, an all dem oda people, wen A been dey wid oona de secon time. Now wiles A gone fom oona, A da waan oona gin. Wen A come back, A gwine punish all dem wa sin, fa true.
Wen A do dat, oona gwine git wa oona wahn, cause oona wahn me fa show oona dat Christ da taak shru me. Christ ain weak wid oona. E powa big mongst oona.

E ain show e powa wen dey kill um pon de cross. Stillyet, God powa mek um lib gin. Same fashion, we wa one wid Christ ain got no powa, bot wiles we da wok wid oona, we gwine lib wid Christ an hab powa wa God da gii we.

Oona mus look ta oona own haat an life fa see ef oona da bleebe een Christ. Oona mus pit oonasef ta de test. Fa sho, oona know dat Jedus Christ dey eenside oona, ainty? Ef oona cyahn shim dey, maybe e ain dey tall!
A da trus dat oona gwine find out dat we done pass de test.
We da pray ta God dat oona ain gwine do wa ain right. Ain jes fa mek people see dat we pass de test, bot dat oona do wa right eben ef e look like we ain pass de test.
Cause we ain got no powa fa do nottin ginst de trute. We jes got powa fa wok fa de trute.
We heppy wen we weak bot oona scrong. We da pray dat God mek oona grow mo an mo een oona waak wid Christ.

A da write dem ting yah ta oona now fo A git dey, cause A hope dat wen A come, A ain gwine haffa deal no scronga wid oona, wid de tority de Lawd gii me. E gii me dat tority fa come hep oona grow op een Christ. E ain gii me dat tority fa stroy oona.

Las ob all, me bredren, goodbye! Try fa grow mo an mo een oona waak wid Christ. Mus pay tention ta wa A da tell oona. Oona mus gree wid one noda an lib peaceable. An God wa da lob we an da gii we peace, e gwine be dey wid oona.
Tell one noda hey een Christian lob.
All God people yah tell oona hey.
A pray dat we Lawd Jedus Christ bless all ob oona, an dat oona gwine know how God da lob oona, an dat oona jine han wid one noda jes like de Holy Sperit mek oona able fa do.
